scope: 70 original story questions from Genesis through 2 Kings. All seven language prompts and labels authored for Hope Cards.
verificationMethod: Retrieved 63 distinct public BSB chapter JSON documents; read the 70 cited verse extracts and checked answers and distractors. Scripture is the factual source, not a third-party quiz bank.
duplicateReview: Compared the tested facts against all 130 pre-existing story questions and all 70 questions in this batch; no rephrased or reversed versions of an existing tested fact were retained. Coordinated parallel-account overlap with the later-OT batch: replaced Hilkiah finding the Law book and Hezekiah receiving fifteen extra years with distinct questions about Josiah tearing his clothes and the shadow moving backward ten steps.
localizationReview: Reviewed each prompt and answer choice for the same meaning across en, ml, de, fr, it, es, fil. Reused base-bank and shared answer labels where available. This is an authored multilingual review, not a claim of independent native-speaker review.

referenceNumberingVerification.interpretation: The left side uses printed Luther numbering; the right side uses English/KJV numbering. These are the only affected references in this batch.

combinedBankDuplicateAudit.scope: All 130 original story questions, all 200 new story questions across the three v3 TSVs, and the role of the 70 preserved passage-reference items. Read every original and new English story prompt, answer, and reference.
combinedBankDuplicateAudit.result: No remaining semantic duplicate found among story questions. No repeated event-detail answer through a parallel biblical account remains in the reviewed additions.
clarifications: A shared person or scene is not automatically the same fact. Existing Joseph-sale identity and new Judah-proposal identity ask different roles; existing five-loaves count and new Andrew-report identity ask different details.

Hilkiah finding the book is only in the later-OT batch; the early-OT question asks Josiah’s response. Hezekiah’s fifteen extra years is only in the later-OT batch; the early-OT question asks the shadow’s ten steps.
The 70 preserved passage-reference items test identifying a scripture location rather than rephrasing the story-fact question.
